_comment: Per-custodian config for automated trade dispatch. interface_type must match the WS Custody Interface dropdown. One download per MAPIN, one email per custodian with all MAPIN attachments.
_report_format_options: XX = XLSX, X = XLS, C = CSV
_template_vars: {mapin} = MAPIN ID, {strategy} = strategy name, {date} = trade date, {custodian} = custodian name
